name: Export the orders, waiting while it works
covers: A button that is greyed out until a box is ticked, slow work with progress, and a helper that takes the file's path out of what the bar at the bottom says

steps.say: Tick I have checked the orders. Export orders stays greyed out until you do
It writes the orders slowly, counting them in the bar at the bottom. The test waits for it to finish, however long that takes, up to a limit.
The bar at the bottom ends with the file it wrote. The suite's exportedFile helper takes the path out of it: ${exportedFile(status)}

checks.label: It said it wrote orders.csv in the data folder
The export has Alan Turing's shipped order
